---
title: "The gacha critical path"
subtitle: "PERT, working days, 2026-08-30"
---

Nine activities stand between the current pipeline and a public roll
button. A pull is not a gacha item until its parts carry the
See-Through taxonomy (VALID_BODY_PARTS_V3, 23 tags; RFD 1121 audited
the canonical body against it). One chain sets the date:
**skin-mode rigging → taxonomy transfer → assembly → pool → publish**,
13.2 expected working days, sigma 1.7. The 10 absent attachment tags
are wave 2 by RFD 1121's own route.

Activity-on-node network on a time axis. Red is the critical path
(A and H both start day zero; I waits for the later of them); dashed
steel edges are non-critical with their slack; the shaded band is the
one-sigma finish window; the green rail is finished work every
activity builds on.

## Estimates

| Node | Activity | Depends on | O | M | P | t~e~ | σ | Slack |
|---|---|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| A | SkinTokens skin-mode against the canonical skeleton — only research risk | rig first light | 2 | 4 | 10 | 4.7 | 1.33 | 0 |
| H | hm08 partition: 9 tags split from geometry, 5 proxies resolved (RFD 1121) | canonical body | 2 | 4 | 8 | 4.3 | 1.00 | 0.4 |
| I | Taxonomy transfer: canonical partition onto each pull, per-vertex tag primvar | A, H | 1 | 3 | 6 | 3.2 | 0.83 | 0 |
| B | UsdSkel writer; VRM humanoid map from ANNY's own bone names | A | 1 | 2 | 4 | 2.2 | 0.50 | 1.0 |
| C | Bend gate: stress battery, EditScore triplets, planted-break control | A | 1 | 2 | 4 | 2.2 | 0.50 | 3.0 |
| D | Seed-to-VRM assembly: one command, all stages | B, I | 1 | 2 | 3 | 2.0 | 0.33 | 0 |
| E | Pool: ~50 pulls generated, gated, reproducible by seed | C, D | 1 | 2 | 4 | 2.2 | 0.50 | 0 |
| F | Cabinet: Godot web export, roll button, viewer, download | — | 2 | 3 | 5 | 3.2 | 0.50 | 8.9 |
| G | Ship: host, sponsor link, automation-disclosure page | E, F | 0.5 | 1 | 2 | 1.1 | 0.25 | 0 |

Method: t~e~ = (O + 4M + P)/6, σ = (P−O)/6. Critical path A–I–D–E–G:
**13.2d expected, σ 1.7** — the one-sigma finish window is day 11.5 to
14.9. Decision rule: A and H start together; nothing else until one of
them moves.

## Ground laid since the last revision

The spend infrastructure the pool leans on, live:

- spot-broker on Fly: the one holder of the vast.ai key; zero-trust
  6PN API, keeper at target zero (RFD 2133)
- weftspun-fdb: 3 machines, double, mutual TLS; the broker's ledger
  survived a machine replacement (RFD 2134)
- continuous backup to Tigris, ~17s behind, with freshness and
  roll-gate machine checks (RFD 2135)

Blocked on the operator:

- vast.ai key rejected (401): E can hold the desk 3090 but cannot rent
  until `fly secrets set VAST_API_KEY` gets a valid key
- Uro holds no broker token yet — nothing can ask for a machine
